source_personality_summary: An ambitious and sharp-minded shopkeeper who runs Connolly's Shop with her mother.
source_knowledge: Keeps track of every debt owed in the parish — knows who can pay and who cannot.
Has connections with merchants in Athlone who bring goods by barge.
Heard from a travelling salesman that linen prices are rising in Belfast.
Suspects the land agent is skimming from the rents he collects.
